name: agent-mesh-bridge
description: Peer-to-Peer Multi-Agent Bridge connecting Google Antigravity, OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude Code, and DeepSeek Harness in VSCode
author: Antigravity Team

agentMeshBridge.defaultAgent.description: Default target agent for task delegation when not explicitly specified.

agentMeshBridge.models.antigravity.markdownDescription: Default model for Google Antigravity (forwarded as `agy --model`). Leave empty to keep the agent's own default. Run **Agent Bridge: Select Model for Agent** to choose from the models reported by `agy models`.

agentMeshBridge.models.codex.markdownDescription: Default model for OpenAI Codex (forwarded as `codex -c model="..."`, so it also applies to resumed sessions). Leave empty to keep the agent's own default. Run **Agent Bridge: Select Model for Agent** to choose from the models reported by `codex debug models`.

agentMeshBridge.models.claudeCode.markdownDescription: Default model for Anthropic Claude Code (forwarded as `claude --model`). Accepts an alias such as `sonnet`/`opus`/`haiku` or a full model id. Leave empty to keep the agent's own default.

agentMeshBridge.models.deepseekHarness.markdownDescription: Default model for bridge-launched DeepSeek Harness runs. DSH has no `--model` flag, so each run receives a generated profile overlay; this requires a configured provider route (`#agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.provider#`). Leave empty to keep the route's own model.

agentMeshBridge.requireModelApproval.markdownDescription: Require an explicit user confirmation (a click in VS Code) before a delegated task runs on a model other than the agent's configured default. With this on, a caller may only switch models when it declares the user asked for that model (`modelRequestedByUser: true`), and the switch still needs your click; a guessed model is ignored and the configured default is used. Turn off only if you want callers to switch models without asking.

agentMeshBridge.maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks stored in the persistent delegation ledger.

agentMeshBridge.contextCompaction.markdownDescription: Condense the previous round's bulky output once a later round has completed (lagged compaction). The current round always stays verbatim for review; the exact original is archived under `~/.agent-mesh-bridge/logs/` and remains readable with `get_round_raw_log`. Turn this off to keep every round verbatim in the ledger.

agentMeshBridge.concurrency.enabled.markdownDescription: Allow more than one delegated task round to run at the same time, one per workspace, up to `#agentMeshBridge.concurrency.maxConcurrentTasks#` mesh-wide. **OFF by default**: the mesh stays strictly single-flight (one round at a time). Even when ON, two tasks in the SAME workspace never overlap, and the file-scope gate, the single-task role lock and pause/delete cancellation are unchanged.

agentMeshBridge.concurrency.maxConcurren.description: Mesh-wide execution slots used when concurrency is enabled (each slot executes one task in one workspace). Ignored while concurrency is off.
How many task rounds a single agent may execute at the same time when concurrency is enabled. Ignored while concurrency is off.

agentMeshBridge.taskTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum execution timeout in minutes for a single task round before terminating (default: 120 mins / 2 hours).

agentMeshBridge.reviewStallTimeoutMinute.markdownDescription: How long a task may stay in `waiting_review` with **no live reviewer process** before the bridge treats the review as stalled: it records the failure (so the task shows "检视卡住" and exposes **Re-Review**) and schedules an automatic re-wake. Raise this if your reviewer's test runs routinely take longer than 10 minutes.

agentMeshBridge.antigravityPath.description: Custom executable path for Google Antigravity (agy).

agentMeshBridge.claudeCodePath.description: Custom executable path for Anthropic Claude Code (claude).

agentMeshBridge.codexPath.description: Custom executable path for OpenAI Codex (codex).

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarnessPath.description: Custom path to the DeepSeek Harness CLI launcher (dsh.cmd / dsh). Leave empty to auto-detect the installation.

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.provider.markdownDescription: Model provider written into the DeepSeek Harness 'headless' profile (e.g. "custom", "commandcode"). 留空时若配置了 Base URL 则自动派生 provider，未配置 Base URL 则使用 DSH 原生 deepseek-official 路由。

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.api.description: Wire protocol used by the configured DeepSeek Harness provider.

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.baseUrl.markdownDescription: DeepSeek Harness API Base URL (调用的 URL / 接口地址)。留空使用 DeepSeek 官方默认接口 (`https://api.deepseek.com`)，也可指定自定义或第三方代理网关 (例如 `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` 或 `https://api.commandcode.ai/provider/v1`)。

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.model.markdownDescription: Default model id for bridge-launched DeepSeek Harness runs (e.g. `deepseek-chat`, `deepseek-reasoner`)。留空时自动派生：命名了 provider 的旧配置沿用该 provider 的既有默认模型，否则使用 `deepseek-chat`。

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.apiKeyEn.markdownDescription: Environment variable the DeepSeek Harness provider reads its API key from. The extension exports this variable to the DSH process it launches. 留空时自动派生：`commandcode` provider 使用 `COMMANDCODE_API_KEY`，其余使用 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`。

agentMeshBridge.deepseekHarness.apiKey.markdownDescription: DeepSeek Harness API Key (调用的 API 密钥)。保存在 machine scope（仅本机有效不随设置同步），将自动注入为对应环境变量供 DeepSeek Harness headless 调用。

agentMeshBridge.autoSyncMcp.description: Automatically sync MCP configuration to Antigravity, Claude, Codex, and DeepSeek Harness profiles on activation.
